mapper.update: create table if not exists compile_article_review_queue ( id bigserial primary key, job_id varchar(64) not null, source_id bigint, source_code varchar(128), concept_id varchar(128) not null, article_key varchar(256) not null, title varchar(255) not null, content text not null, lifecycle varchar(32) not null default 'ACTIVE', compiled_at timestamptz not null, source_paths text[] not null default array[]::text[], metadata_json jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb, review_status varchar(32) not null default 'needs_human_review', review_route varchar(128), reviewer_model varchar(256), review_issues_json jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb, fix_attempt_count integer not null default 0, max_fix_rounds integer not null default 0, created_at timestamptz not null default current_timestamp, updated_at timestamptz not null default current_timestamp, reviewed_by varchar(128), reviewed_at timestamptz, review_comment text, published_article_key varchar(256) ); create unique index if not exists uk_compile_article_review_queue_job_concept on compile_article_review_queue (job_id, concept_id); create index if not exists idx_compile_article_review_queue_status_created_at on compile_article_review_queue (review_status, created_at desc, id desc); create index if not exists idx_compile_article_review_queue_job_id on compile_article_review_queue (job_id); create index if not exists idx_compile_article_review_queue_source_id on compile_article_review_queue (source_id); create index if not exists idx_compile_article_review_queue_article_key on compile_article_review_queue (article_key)
mapper.insert: insert into compile_article_review_queue ( job_id, source_id, source_code, concept_id, article_key, title, content, lifecycle, compiled_at, source_paths, metadata_json, review_status, review_route, reviewer_model, review_issues_json, fix_attempt_count, max_fix_rounds ) values ( #{record.jobId}, #{record.sourceId}, #{record.sourceCode}, #{record.conceptId}, #{record.articleKey}, #{record.title}, #{record.content}, #{record.lifecycle}, #{record.compiledAt}, #{record.sourcePaths,typeHandler=com.xbk.lattice.infra.persistence.mybatis.StringListArrayTypeHandler}, #{record.metadataJson,typeHandler=com.xbk.lattice.infra.persistence.mybatis.PostgresJsonbTypeHandler}, 'needs_human_review', #{record.reviewRoute}, #{record.reviewerModel}, #{record.reviewIssuesJson,typeHandler=com.xbk.lattice.infra.persistence.mybatis.PostgresJsonbTypeHandler}, #{record.fixAttemptCount}, #{record.maxFixRounds} ) on conflict (job_id, concept_id) do update set source_id = excluded.source_id, source_code = excluded.source_code, article_key = excluded.article_key, title = excluded.title, content = excluded.content, lifecycle = excluded.lifecycle, compiled_at = excluded.compiled_at, source_paths = excluded.source_paths, metadata_json = excluded.metadata_json, review_route = excluded.review_route, reviewer_model = excluded.reviewer_model, review_issues_json = excluded.review_issues_json, fix_attempt_count = excluded.fix_attempt_count, max_fix_rounds = excluded.max_fix_rounds, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where compile_article_review_queue.review_status = 'needs_human_review'
mapper.select: select from compile_article_review_queue order by created_at desc, id desc limit #{limit}

select coalesce(sum(case when review_status = 'needs_human_review' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pending_human_review_count, coalesce(sum(case when review_status = 'published' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as published_count, coalesce(sum(case when review_status = 'rejected' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as rejected_count from compile_article_review_queue where job_id = #{jobId}
mapper.update: update compile_article_review_queue set review_status = 'published', reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, published_article_key = #{publishedArticleKey}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where id = #{id} and review_status = 'needs_human_review'

update compile_article_review_queue set review_status = 'rejected', reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where id = #{id} and review_status = 'needs_human_review'
